name: subway_5g_network_deployment
description: Synthetic Category contract case (RC-66): a carrier completes 5G deployment across operating subway lines.

candidates.title: Carrier completes 5G coverage on most operating subway lines
candidates.search_snippet: A mobile carrier has upgraded its network in the city's operating subway lines to 5G.
candidates.source_content: A mobile carrier said it has deployed 5G base stations and antennas in the tunnels and stations of the city's operating subway lines, so that more than 70 percent of the network now has 5G coverage. The carrier describes the new radio equipment installed for the underground sections.
